'''Capt_WaRPed Let's Duel (HDADTJ)''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[Capt_WaRPed]]
* '''Published:''' 9 December 2001 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Theed Palace]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi / Their Fire Has Gone Out Of The Universe|SE-D-huntdownanddestroythejedi.gif|label=Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PTheed HD Capt_WaRPed DS 2001 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This classic Hunt Down Deck goes out to duel.  It has beaten even saber combat decks.  Win the Podrace and let the bad guys take over.

== Strategy ==

A very straight-forward deck, it allows you to go to your opponent and make them scramble from the word go.  You activate almost enough by yourself to deploy Vader the first turn (you only need one from your opponent).  With almost half the deck (after starting stuff) with destiny 5 or greater, it owns the podrace.  Use Dark Rage and Deep Hatred to start stacking the destiny early.  After the first battle, most players are leary of trying to battle you again when you pull 2 or 3 destiny totaling AT LEAST 10.  It is weak against Hidden Base with only 1 ship, so I may stock another Infiltrator (gotta love the D6).  Emperor Palpatine would there if I had him.
